faq.a: Nazmi is associated with the Arabic form نَظْمِي, whose core sense is nazmi; of order, of verse.

faq.q: What is the origin of Nazmi?
faq.a: Nazmi is associated with Arabic. Nazmi is Arabic نَظْمِي (Naẓmī) 'of order, of verse', a relational adjective from نَظْم (naẓm). The source gloss 'Graceful' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense.
Yes — the underlying form نَظْمِي is Arabic.

faq.q: What does Nazmi mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Nazmi is rendered نظمی and carries the sense نظمی، منسوب به نظم.

faq.q: What are the variants of Nazmi?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Nazmi, nazmi. Script forms are نظمي, نظمی, نَظْمِي, नज़मी.

faq.q: Is Nazmi a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
